postSubject: I've put this in the form of a discussion because comments on your recent post cant be longer than 1000 characters, so here it is.The series had a low life expectancy, in terms of years. You have made a huge impact on the gaming community, but you have gone too far this time. Releasing an unfinished game that still requires months of work. Yes, you realise your mistakes, but there is little room for mistakes like this in the gaming industry. As you have stated, you IGNORED features that are key to an RPG, that you were told about, features that make the game terrible without them. At the moment it is a poor graphic button mashing game. There are no excuses for this, no fallback option, you have made a serious mistake, and there will be consequences. We understand you were excited, but still... it's just not good enough. As a true fan of the series, i think you need to fix this game, and move on to something else. Five nights at freddys will still be influencial to us, but we don't to see it deteoriorate into bad quality attempts at keeping the series alive. Take some time to think about it, Scott. Really think about what you want to do.
